instruction: I want to disable the display of inline images from remote servers for security reasons. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to block remote content in emails?

metadata.explanation: Task requires blocking remote content (images, scripts) in emails by setting mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image to true. This security feature prevents automatic loading of content from remote servers that could track email opens.
metadata.verification: The preference mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image is a standard Thunderbird privacy setting. Setting it to true blocks remote content loading.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches Thunderbird prefs.js file using get_vm_file
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses JavaScript-style preference declarations and verifies the exact preference key
Expected value correctly specifies mailnews.message_display.disable_remote_image = true, which is the standard Thunderbird setting for blocking remote content
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before reading
Complete coverage: instruction requires blocking remote content, evaluator verifies the single preference that controls this behavior
Metric function correctly handles expected parameter - receives rules dict directly from get_rule() and accesses rule.get('expect', {})

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
